notes: Companions answer name-only wakes faster using prepared greetings in their own voices.
Full questions after the name are still transcribed; mute and follow-up listening are preserved.
Fixed repeated screen-capture agreement windows when the first prompt was left unanswered.
Only one screen or image permission prompt can be open at a time.
Declining keeps automatic capture off, and the choice is remembered.
Permission responses from a closed app or changed account are ignored.
